description: Read a WBS outline and splice one detail-authoring plan step per work item into the active plan. Deterministic — no thinking model call.
embedding_description: Graft WBS detail authoring steps into the active plan from a completed outline. Deterministic splice operation that creates one plan step per work item, plus assembly and execution graft steps. Second step of detailed WBS authoring.

result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: WBS detail authoring steps have been grafted into the plan. Continue to the next step to author individual work item details.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Grafting WBS detail steps from an outline. graft_work_breakdown_structure_detail_steps accepts {outline_id, anchor_step_number}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: MissingOutline: the outline_id does not exist or has been superseded. PlanGraftError: the active plan does not contain the anchor step number.
